specs.title: NUMA-Aware Actor Thread Pinning and Memory Allocation

drifted.spec_text: Actors are single-use; re-activation requires constructing a new Actor instance. Edge Cases: 'Actor is consumed on activation.'
drifted.actual: Actor::activate(&self) takes &self and does not consume; deactivate() resets state to IDLE, so a second activate() passes the CAS and then panics on the already-taken receiver/handler rather than being compile-time prevented or returning a typed error.
